scientific_limitations: Exact results concern connected finite serial transitive Euclidean (KD45) frames and their finite powerset modal algebras; not arbitrary disconnected KD45 frames or KD5 frames. The forest identity and KD45 frame normal form are previously established ingredients. No independent mathematical or originality audit has been carried out.
title: Rooted-forest dynamics and complete image spectra of connected finite KD45 modal algebras
